org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model

Class RefMapConfigDefaults

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model.RefMapConfigDefaults

  • @Entity
public class RefMapConfigDefaults
extends Object
    Configuration entity class representing the RefMapConfigDefaults table. This information does not need to be stored with a procedure (it already is as part of the ProcedureConfig), and hence this does not conform to the standard inheritance model and there is no corresponding RefMapConfig table.

    smichaels
